title.narrative: Twinning on Systematisation and Simplification of the Regulatory Framework in Uzbekistan

description.narrative:
Overall objective: The overall objective is to support Uzbekistan¿s reforms towards creating an enabling regulatory environment for trade and economic development in the country.

Specific objectives: SO1: Ministry of Justice strengthens its organisational, administrative, technical and legal capacity to ensure high quality, predictable and accountable regulatory framework; SO2: Creation of a high-quality and compact system of normative and technical regulations.
